newsitem.title: FRANCE: Soccer-Bordeaux ex-president faces new trial.
newsitem.headline: Soccer-Bordeaux ex-president faces new trial.

text.p: Claude Bez, the ex-president of Bordeaux football club already in prison for embezzling public funds, faces a new trial next year over transfer fraud, court sources said on Thursday.
Bez faces trial along with Didier Couecou, Bordeaux's chief executive when the club were France's best in the 1980s, and two agents, Ljubomir Barin and Lucio D'Onofrio.

He received a three-year sentence, with half suspended, in connection with work at Bordeaux's Haillan training facility, where he obtained advances of 50 million francs ($10 million) of public funds but spent only half the amount.
Couecou and Bez were placed under provisional arrest for about two months in 1992 in connection with the investigation into the transfers, which has taken judges seven years.
Bez was forced to resign when the transfer affair became public in 1990 and Bordeaux were found to have a deficit of 305 million francs ($60 million).
